model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the ‘effect’ values for various language models, categorized by language family. The horizontal axis represents the language families, including IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, ordered from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled ‘effect’, ranges from approximately 0 to 30 and utilizes a linear scale with tick intervals of 5, displaying values in units of ‘effect’.  Each bar represents a specific language model, with the height of each bar indicating its ‘effect’ value, accompanied by error bars representing the standard error. The ‘mBERT-L2’ bar, colored in gold, is the tallest, reaching a value of approximately 28. The ‘mBERT-R2’ bar, colored in dark orange, is the second tallest, reaching a value of approximately 26. The ‘XLM-L2’ bar, colored in gray, reaches a value of approximately 22. The ‘mBERT-R’ bar, colored in red, reaches a value of approximately 16. The ‘mBERT-B2’ bar, colored in purple, reaches a value of approximately 13. The ‘XLM-B2’ bar, colored in light blue, reaches a value of approximately 10. The ‘mBERT-B’ bar, colored in teal, reaches a value of approximately 8. The bars are not sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized.
